name: smwmusic-cool-spot-genesis-rave-dancetune
title: Cool Spot (Genesis) - Rave Dancetune
description:
Also known as Bonus Level in other versions, an upbeat theme of a short bonus level.
A version without the pitch bends intro is included. If you want to use the version without the intro, change the "No_Intro" define to 1.
08/05 Update: Fixed the samples, and made the txt much more readable. Changed the "no intro" txt file to a simple #define.
